policy: To receive benefits, an injured employee must report the injury to the employer within 30 days of its occurrence. An injury reported more than 30 days after it occurs is barred from compensation.
scenario: On March 1, Priya twisted her knee lifting a box at the warehouse. She did not mention it to anyone at first. She finally reported the injury to her supervisor on April 20 of the same year, 50 days later.
question: Is Priya's injury claim barred for late reporting?
